query: Which double-spike isotope pairs and spike calibration workflows are recommended for high-precision Sn double-spike MC-ICP-MS?

response.query: Which double-spike isotope pairs and spike calibration workflows are recommended for high-precision Sn double-spike MC-ICP-MS?
response.answer: For high-precision Sn double-spike MC-ICP-MS, the recommended isotope pairs are 112Cd+114Cd and 120Sn+122Sn. The spike calibration workflow typically involves external standardization with matrix-matched standards.

results.title: 187 Os geochronometer to crustal materials: Systematics ...
results.content: With blanks at these levels, it is possible to accurately measure the isotopic ratios of mineral or shale samples containing sub-parts-per-billion (ppb) Re concentrations and parts-per-trillion (ppt) Os (e.g., Rooney et al., 2014; Strauss et al., 2014; Paradis et al., 2020; Saintilan et al., 2020a). Analysis of Os isotopes using MC-ICP-MS systems has been investigated thoroughly by research groups primarily studying non-radiogenic materials such as mantle rocks (e.g., Nowell et al., 2008; Luguet et al., 2008; Luguet and Pearson, 2019). Improving the accuracy of the 187 Re decay constant (λ 187 Re) is a major goal of the EARTHTIME initiative, because analytical uncertainties in a variety of Re-Os isotopic datasets have reached precision equal to or greater than that of the decay constant (e.g., Spencer et al., 2015; Li et al., 2017b). Recent work on a low-level, highly radiogenic chalcopyrite reference material sourced from the Xiaotongchang copper deposit that is homogeneous in reference to Re and 187 Os concentrations and model age determinations (229.3 ± 3.7 Ma) provides a major boost for non-molybdenite Re-Os sulfide work (Li et al., 2022).
